name: B10-0586/2025 (PPE) – Grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
part_text:
**What it asks for:** The European Parliament condemns the military takeover in Guinea-Bissau on 26 November 2025, which stopped an election count one day before results were due. It calls for the release of detained opposition leader Domingos Simões Pereira and everyone else held, and for the election results to be published. It urges the junta to restore constitutional order and lift restrictions on independent media. It also calls for reforms of the security sector, with regional support. The text is a statement of position, not a law.

**What concretely changes, who it affects, what happens next:**
- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and demands.
- It concerns Guinea-Bissau's junta, detained politicians, media and citizens.
- Parliament sends the text to the Council, Commission, regional bodies and Guinea-Bissau's authorities.
